_references.alpha: Derived from VDT meta-analysis (Usuda et al. EJCA 2024); alpha=ln(2)/(VDT*ln(V_max/V0))
_references.beta: Benzekry S et al. Sci Rep 2019;9:12598 (NSCLC-specific)
_references.V0: Liu Z et al. Sci Rep 2017;7:13646 (NSCLC stage-specific)
_references.delta_c: Liu Z et al. Sci Rep 2017;7:13646 (NSCLC chemo, beta_c=0.028)
_references.delta_i: Kuznetsov VA et al. Bull Math Biol 1994; adapted
_references.s_E: Kuznetsov VA et al. Bull Math Biol 1994
_references.mu_E: Kuznetsov VA et al. Bull Math Biol 1994
_references.rho: Kuznetsov VA et al. 1994; Wodarz D 2005
_references.sigma: Kuznetsov VA et al. Bull Math Biol 1994
_references.delta_EV: Kuznetsov VA et al. Bull Math Biol 1994
_references.delta_t: Inferred from FLAURA trial; Pilla Reddy et al. 2024
_references.k_immune: Derived from delta_i * E0 (Kuznetsov 1994); adjusted for NSCLC calibration

_references.E_ref: Same as E0 (Kuznetsov 1994); normalization for fractional immune kill
